Company_Overview.Entity_Name: PT Indofood CBP Sukses Makmur Tbk
Company_Overview.Parent_Company: PT Indofood Sukses Makmur Tbk (INDF) - 80.53% ownership
Company_Overview.Core_Business: Established market-leading producer of branded packaged food and beverage products in Indonesia and global emerging markets.
Company_Overview.Key_Moat: Dominant national distribution network (via Indomarco Adi Prima), irreplaceable brand equity (Indomie), immense manufacturing scale economies (>37 billion noodle packs/yr).

Operational_Divisions.Capacity: >37 billion packs per year across 30+ manufacturing plants
Operational_Divisions.Market_Share: ~70% - 72% in Indonesia; Dominant market leader in Nigeria (>70%), Egypt (>85%), Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Serbia, Kenya
Operational_Divisions.Strategic_Role: Core earnings driver and high-margin cash cow (EBIT margin ~25%-26%).

Operational_Divisions.Market_Share: #2 player in Indonesia dairy market behind Frisian Flag
Operational_Divisions.Strategic_Role: Stable domestic volume contributor; benefiting from premiumization and BPOM 'Pilihan Lebih Sehat' launches.

Operational_Divisions.Market_Share: #1 in Western-style extruded and potato chips, #1 in cassava chips (Qtela)
Operational_Divisions.Strategic_Role: High-growth segment appealing to younger demographics and impulsive snacking.

Operational_Divisions.Market_Share: Leading position in culinary seasonings, instant recipe mixes, and chili sauces
Operational_Divisions.Strategic_Role: Synergistic with noodles and domestic cooking habits.

Operational_Divisions.Market_Share: Leader in complementary baby food (MP-ASI) and infant cereals
Operational_Divisions.Strategic_Role: High brand trust among pediatric demographic.

Operational_Divisions.Market_Share: Top-tier ready-to-drink tea (Ichi Ocha) and mineral water (Club)
Operational_Divisions.Strategic_Role: Turnaround division achieving positive and expanding EBIT margins.

Domestic_Market.Distribution_Infrastructure: Over 60 distribution centers and 1,300+ stock points covering >500,000 retail outlets across 17,000+ islands.

International_Markets.Pinehill_Footprint: Direct production facilities in 8 countries (Saudi Arabia, Nigeria, Egypt, Turkey, Serbia, Kenya, Ghana, Morocco) serving over 885 million consumers.

Corporate_Actions_Timeline.Action: Initial Public Offering (IPO) on Indonesia Stock Exchange
Corporate_Actions_Timeline.Details: Offered 1,166,191,000 shares at Rp 5,395/share. Total issued shares: 5,830,954,000. Raised Rp 6.29 Trillion.
Par value halved from Rp 100 to Rp 50 per share. Total shares doubled to 11,661,908,000 to increase stock liquidity.

Acquired 100% of Pinehill Company Limited for USD 2.998 Billion (~Rp 44 Trillion), transforming ICBP from a domestic champion into a global instant noodle powerhouse. Financed by USD 2.05 Billion syndicated bank facilities and internal cash.
Issued $1.15B 3.399% bonds due 2031 and $600M 4.745% bonds due 2051 to refinance syndicated acquisition debt and extend maturity profile.
Issued $1.0B 5.415% bonds due 2032 to complete debt liability management.

Growth_Catalysts: Rising global penetration of instant noodles in Pinehill geographies (Africa & Middle East have per-capita noodle consumption <15 packs/yr vs Indonesia's >50 packs/yr).
Secular domestic consumer spending growth anchored by young demographics and rising middle-class disposable income.
Premium product innovation (Indomie Premium Collection: Tori Miso, Shoyu, Korean Ramyeon series; Indomilk Korean Milk).
Moat_and_Pricing_Power: Unmatched brand equity allowing ICBP to regularly implement 2%-5% price hikes to offset input inflation with negligible demand elasticity.
Incomparable logistics reach preventing new entrants from achieving viable scale.
Key_Risks: USD/IDR depreciation resulting in non-cash foreign exchange translation losses on USD 2.75B global bonds.
Raw material commodity volatility: Wheat (flour), Crude Palm Oil (frying), and Resin (packaging).
Regulatory sugar tax implementation risk on beverages and sweet dairy.
